VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: The theorem assumes \(a<b\) (nondegenerate interval) and \(c\in[a,b]\). The proof treats the cases \(x<c\), \(x=c\), \(x>c\) explicitly using the oriented integral; the uniform estimate holds because \(|x-c|\le b-a < b-a+1\). No counterexample was found—the result is the standard theorem on differentiation of uniformly convergent sequences.
